nodes.name: PRIVILEGE_MODEL.md
nodes.summary: Comprehensive specification of the SETURA database privilege model, defining the four SECURITY DEFINER categories (A, B, C, D), three enforcement layers, hardened tables, and the regression-tested boundary enforced by migration 48.
nodes.languageNotes: Documents the 4-category privilege taxonomy (A=4, B=145, B-trigger=10, C=10, D=24) with explicit per-routine ACL targets and includes live-verification SQL queries.

nodes.name: WEBHOOK_SIGNATURE_BOUNDARY.md
nodes.summary: Phase 1.5 D-2 decision document covering the fail-closed Meta WhatsApp webhook signature verification and the JWT boundary configuration state, including 5 typed rejection outcomes and deployment operator confirmation requirements.
nodes.languageNotes: Documents 5 webhook verification outcomes (secret_missing/signature_missing/signature_malformed/signature_invalid/ok) with constant-time HMAC comparison and 18 unit test assertions.

nodes.name: RPC_PRIVILEGE_CLASSIFICATION
nodes.summary: Authoritative TSV classification of all SETURA SECURITY DEFINER routines with pg_proc-derived arguments, volatility, return type, category (A/B/B-trigger/C/D), and target execute roles. Lists 193 RPCs spanning internal edge, admin, financial, and trigger-only categories.
